feedback.Physical Object: Excluded — A national anthem is not a bounded material object.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — Composed and authored by humans; a deliberate cultural creation.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — Not derived from biological processes or models.
feedback.Powered: Excluded — The concept does not depend on energy to exist.
feedback.Structural: Excluded — Does not bear or support physical structures.
feedback.Observable: Excluded — The anthem as a concept is abstract; performances are observable, but the entity is symbolic.
feedback.Physical Medium: Excluded — Exists across formats (sheet music, audio files) but is not defined by any single one.
feedback.Active: Excluded — Requires performers or systems; not independently active.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Created with purpose to represent national identity and unify people.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Excluded — Any effect depends on context or performance, not intrinsic to the anthem.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Excluded — Does not perform transformations or computations.
feedback.State-Transforming: Excluded — May evoke emotion or affiliation but does not change internal state structurally.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Excluded — Not interactive by design; it is presented, not engaged with responsively.
feedback.System-integrated: Excluded — Used by systems (e.g., ceremonies), but not a functional subsystem.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Excluded — Requires human or institutional actors to manifest.
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Symbolically important, but not operationally essential to a nation-state.
feedback.Symbolic: Included — Represents the nation, its values, and collective identity.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Communicates patriotism, allegiance, and unity through musical and verbal cues.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Composed within musical structures: meter, harmony, repetition, phrasing.
feedback.Compositional: Included — Made of interrelated musical parts (verses, chorus, etc.) with internal structure.
feedback.Normative: Included — Carries social expectation of respect, decorum, and ceremonial use.
feedback.Meta: Excluded — Does not reference itself or its category.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Defined by rhythm, meter, duration, and performance in time.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Stored, shared, and enacted in digital formats; not bound to physical form.
feedback.Social Construct: Included — Its meaning and role exist through collective agreement.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Included — Designated by governments or national constitutions.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Included — Directly associated with national identity and belonging.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Often governed by formal rules (e.g., flag codes, laws).
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Used in monetized events, cultural products, and symbolic branding.
feedback.Politicised: Included — Carries political symbolism, often subject to debate or protest.
feedback.Ritualised: Included — Performed in standardized ways in official ceremonies and events.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Its use evokes moral expectations of respect, protest, or allegiance.

encoding_notes: This encoding treats the national anthem as a symbolic, musical, and institutional construct. While physically instantiated in performances and recordings, its core identity is abstract, socially defined, and temporally enacted. The inclusion of rule-governed and compositional traits reflects its structured nature as a musical form.
